claims.report_quote: - Several client errors get the wrong status. Malformed identity JSON, bad body JSON and validation errors return 400 by default, and the raw `error.message` goes to the client. That includes `JSON.parse` messages and `source too large`. Upstream failures should map to 502 or 504 with generic text.
claims.reason: All caught messages are returned; errors without status become 400, wrong token/project retain 401/403.
